name: Navata (Spain)
description: Divided per bend sinister into two equal parts, the upper red and the lower divided again per bend sinister white and yellow, with a blue rock outlined yellow in the upper hoist canton.
history: The flag was approved on 11 April 1994 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya; it is an oblong flag of 2:3 divided per bend sinister into two equal parts, the upper red and the lower divided again per bend sinister into white and yellow halves, with a blue rock outlined yellow of 1/3 of the height in the canton, 1/9 from the corner.

features.role: white band between the red and the yellow
rock outlined yellow in the canton, 1/3 of the height
